name: Yoshino Sakura
source: [url=/c4020]Jun'ichi's[/url] cousin and first love. She is a very lively girl who shows great affection towards Jun'ichi, much to [url=/c4012]Nemu's[/url] dismay. She is sometimes seen with [url=/c4022]Utamaru[/url], a white cat. Actually older than Jun'ichi. She inherited her grandmother's magical ability, and despite the passing of several years, her appearance remains largely unchanged from what Jun'ichi and Nemu remember. Has an IQ of 180.
